P30.help_text:
orca orchestration ask

Usage: orca orchestration ask (--question <text> | --resume <message_id>) [--to <run:id>] [--run <run_id>] [--options <csv>] [--timeout-ms <n>] [--from <handle>] [--retry-request <id>] [--json]

Ask the coordinator a question and block until answered

Options:
  --help                 Show this help message
  --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON
  --pairing-code
  --environment
  --to
  --run
  --question
  --resume
  --dispatch-capability
  --options
  --timeout-ms <ms>     Maximum wait time before timing out
  --from
  --retry-request

Notes:
  From an active Dispatch, a new question defaults to its owning Run mailbox.
  Timeout leaves the question pending; resume with the original message ID.
P30.ask_command: orca orchestration ask --from <handle> --dispatch-capability <cap> --question "P30 probe: timeout test (35s). Reply with any text or ignore." --options "ack,ignore" --timeout-ms 35000 --json
observations: Timeout outcome: ok=true, result.timedOut=true, answer=null, cancelled=false, connectionLost=false; process exit code 1.
Help text documents --resume <message_id> and states 'Timeout leaves the question pending; resume with the original message ID.'
Resume returned the SAME messageId/threadId (msg_c2f66ec990b3); still pending (timedOut=true again, answer=null) because the coordinator had not replied within the second 35s window.
Each call has a distinct envelope id and distinct mutation.requestId; replayed=false on both, so resume is a new wait on the same durable question, not a replay.
No explicit 'state' field in the envelope; pending-ness is inferred from timedOut=true + answer=null with the same messageId.
